model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability values for the MistralV0.2-Base model, fine-tuned on different medical specialties. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—listed in that order, and is categorical without a specified scale. The vertical axis represents negative log probability, labeled as “Negative log probability”, with a linear scale ranging from approximately -22 to -27, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. For each specialty, there are two bars: a light orange bar representing the fine-tuned model and a pale blue bar representing the base model. The bars are displayed in pairs, side-by-side, grouped by specialty. For Cardio, the light orange bar extends to approximately -22.3 and the pale blue bar extends to approximately -22.7. For Pediatrics, the light orange bar extends to approximately -26.3 and the pale blue bar extends to approximately -26.8. The bars are not sorted by any apparent order and no bars are visually emphasized.
